name: Iron PPL
subject: Strength
blurb: Classic push, pull and legs days with heavier dumbbell and kettlebell work in straight sets.

name: Upper/Lower Power
subject: Strength
blurb: Alternating upper and lower days built from supersets: two exercises back to back, then rest.

name: Full-Body Strength 3×
subject: Strength
blurb: Three rotating full-body days of heavy compound pairs as supersets.

name: Pull-Up Ladder
subject: Pull-ups
blurb: Upper days open with a pull-up ladder (1, 2, 3… reps), plus negatives and holds; lower days keep the legs strong.
gear: Optional: a resistance band for assisted reps

name: Bar Master
subject: Pull-ups
blurb: Every day starts with a pull-up EMOM: a few quality reps at the top of each minute, then full-body strength.
gear: Optional: a resistance band for assisted reps

name: Grip & Hang
subject: Pull-ups
blurb: Pull days mix chin-ups, hangs and holds with rows as supersets; push and legs days keep everything balanced.

name: Engine
subject: Conditioning
blurb: Full-body circuits with short rests, finished by an AMRAP: as many rounds as you can in a few minutes.

name: Storm Front
subject: Conditioning
blurb: Alternates kettlebell EMOMs with bodyweight Tabata intervals (20 s hard, 10 s rest).

name: Tabata Ten
subject: Conditioning
blurb: Tabata blocks (20 s on, 10 s off) followed by a kettlebell AMRAP finisher.

name: Core Foundations
subject: Mobility & core
blurb: Anti-extension, anti-rotation and carry days, each with a mobility flow and a little strength.

name: Flow State
subject: Mobility & core
blurb: Longer mobility flows, core circuits and light strength. Good between harder weeks.

name: Deep Core 60
subject: Mobility & core
blurb: Alternates slow, long-hold core strength with mobility and loaded carries.

name: One Bell
subject: Kettlebell only
blurb: Everything with one bell: swings, cleans, presses, squats and get-ups in straight sets.
gear: Level III: a 20–24 kg kettlebell helps

name: Bell Complexes
subject: Kettlebell only
blurb: Kettlebell complexes as EMOMs: chain several moves each minute without putting the bell down, then strength work.
gear: Level III: a 20–24 kg kettlebell helps

name: Swing Century
subject: Kettlebell only
blurb: A swing EMOM every day that builds toward 100+ swings, plus presses and squats.

name: 20 Flat
subject: Busy week
blurb: Twenty-minute full-body supersets for tight days.

name: Minute Man
subject: Busy week
blurb: One EMOM a day: a new exercise at the top of every minute, then abs. No rest to plan.

name: Twenty Ladder
subject: Busy week
blurb: Rep ladders against the clock: 1 rep of each move, then 2, then 3… climb as high as you can before time runs out.

name: Hotel Room
subject: Bodyweight
blurb: Only a mat or a towel. Full-body circuits for trips and days away from your weights.

name: Skill Ladder
subject: Bodyweight
blurb: Bodyweight skill progressions: archer push-ups, shrimp squats, hollow rocks. Harder versions arrive at Level II.

name: No-Gear Burn
subject: Bodyweight
blurb: Bodyweight supersets with a short AMRAP burnout at the end.

name: Lower Focus
subject: Legs & glutes
blurb: Two lower-body days for every upper day, in straight sets.

name: Posterior Chain
subject: Legs & glutes
blurb: Glute and hamstring emphasis with slow lowering and pauses.

name: Single-Leg Strong
subject: Legs & glutes
blurb: Split squats, single-leg deadlifts and pistol-style progressions for balanced legs.
